name: Revealing Secrets
overview: Scripture reveals that certain things are intentionally concealed by God, as it is His glory to hide mysteries, while human wisdom is called to diligently seek understanding (Proverbs 25:2). The secret things belong to the Lord alone, but what He reveals is entrusted to His people for obedience and instruction (Deuteronomy 29:29). God alone knows the deep and hidden realities, yet He discloses what is necessary, guiding the faithful away from deceit and towards wise counsel (Daniel 2:22; Job 5:12; Proverbs 1:5). Believers are warned against careless disclosure of secrets, emphasizing the value of faithfulness and discretion (Proverbs 11:13).
